head: Qwen3-8B opened the hidden link when the list gave its words, and almost never when the list gave only addresses
sub: Same agent (Qwen3-8B, thinking on), same page, same question. Only the link list differs.
qa: Question: fitted on half the setups, does a two-number rule (how often the tool shows a link × how often the model follows links) predict how often an agent opens a hidden link in each other setup, within 10 points? Answer: Not settled, neither yes nor no. The rule missed {WHO} on {FMT} by {MISS} points (predicted {PRED}, measured {CATCH}), but with 42 runs the true miss might be only {LO} points, inside the 10-point limit.
key: Saw the address: the link's random code was in what the tool returned. Requested it: our server logged a visit to that address.
foot: Test websites we built; gpt-oss-20b and Qwen3-8B run locally, Nov 23 2026
